verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ramp has a built-in role model: admin, business owner and employee tiers, and "every action respects the authenticated user's role" (ramp-supp-ai-agents-channels, ramp-supp-mcp-server). It also offers entity-level restrictions in multi-entity setups (ramp-docs-14), and admins can restrict MCP access by roles, departments or specific users. However, that department-based control is scoped to the MCP integration, and nothing documents defining custom granular roles in the core product. missing for 10: documentation of custom or granular role definitions, permission assignment by location, department-level permission controls beyond MCP access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
